badges.name: Tilbage til afsender
badges.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one premium cartoon 3D Christmas achievement badge icon for a Danish game. Reference image is STYLE AND CAT IDENTITY only, not a target to copy. Match glossy polished red/green/gold Christmas objects, soft lavender-grey plush Miv cat, huge amber eyes, pink nose. Compact cohesive square composition, generous safe margins, genuinely transparent alpha background. No background panel, no watermark, no badge title, no outer medal rim. Subject: a single luxurious red wrapped Christmas gift with gold bow, surrounded by ONE thick shiny curved green return arrow curling around it and pointing back toward the gift. Small holly leaves and fir accents. Strong simple readable silhouette at tiny icon size. No cat needed, no text or numbers. Meaning: stealing back your own gift.
